errors.text: The material is misidentified as a generic TaNbHfZrTi-type alloy rather than the target TaVCrW composition.
The proposed 5% free-energy error tolerance is too loose for resolving the sub-meV/atom differences required for accurate melting-point prediction; the target agreement is below 0.5 meV/atom.

The cited evidence concerns dislocation mobility and SRO in solid MoNbTaW and does not validate MTP-based free-energy perturbation, liquid-phase fidelity, melting calculations, or the claimed speedup.
